get.description: The root's own diagnostics, asked once per request (no background polling; answers within 1 s are shared). 503 ROOT_UNAVAILABLE without a root session. A value the root cannot know is absent and listed in `unknown`, never 0. driver = platform facts, sdk = owner counters, app = the application's view.

get.description: The newest backup of the root's member ledger the Host holds for the domain (CONFIGURE: it lists the members and their credentials). The Host asks the root for a fresh one after its ledger changed; one per domain, the highest sequence wins and a lower one never replaces it. backup_b64 is what POST /v1/control LEDGER_RESTORE can carry.

400.description: Invalid input or unknown critical field

404.description: Unknown domain, or no backup has been taken yet

410.description: Cursor gap or expired query window

U63.description: Decimal integer string, exact value 0..9223372036854775807; runtime must range-check.

kind.description: Reserved; current Host bridge returns 503 UNSUPPORTED before admission.

type.description: LEAVE is reserved; current Host bridge returns 503 UNSUPPORTED before admission. LEDGER_RESTORE (issue #5) restores the root's ledger onto a replacement root: signed_cbor_b64 is the fleet's RootHandover (type 31) that names that root, expected_revision is the sequence of the backup restored (409 with details.current_revision when the Host holds another); needs CONFIGURE and TRANSFER.

join_mode.description: POLICY_SET only: the root's join mode (lm_policy_set). PREAPPROVED still admits only a device with a fleet-signed AssignmentTicket and a signed expected entry; expected_revision is the policy revision of GET /v1/policy.

backup_b64.description: LEDGER_RESTORE only, optional: a backup (GET /v1/ledger/backup backup_b64) to restore instead of the one the Host holds; it must be at least as new (expected_revision is its sequence) and becomes the held one.

parent_device_id.description: The node's approved parent in the root's tree: the root's own DeviceId for a direct child of the root, else the parent node's DeviceId. Absent when the node has no approved parent (admitted but not attached, or its lease ran out) or the root did not report one. Reported by the root's NODE_QUERY; the Host refreshes it on membership events and at least every 10 s.

root_depth.description: Hops from the root in the approved tree: 1 = a direct child of the root. Absent when the node has no approved parent. Reported with parent_device_id.

revision.description: decimal integer; numeric upper bound 2^63-1 also checked

reported_root_ms.description: Root clock at which the root received the member's schedule report (Host-served snapshots only).

report_age_ms.description: Upper bound of the report's age when served. state is SLEEPING only while the report is in force and UNKNOWN once its reported wake has passed.

age_ms.description: 0 = asked of the root now; else the shared answer of the last second.

unknown.description: Names ("group.field") the root could not provide.

sequence.description: The root's backup sequence number: persisted by the root before it signs, never repeats nor goes back, continued by a replacement root. LEDGER_RESTORE takes it as expected_revision.

root_device_id.description: The root that signed the backup.

taken_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when the Host stored it.

backup_b64.description: CBOR [1, signed header (control type 34), [[record id, state, payload, next], ...]]. The Host checked that the records are the ones the header names (hash chain); the root that is restored from it verifies the signature.
